name: HYDRA-UMC-VISION-STREAMER
notes: Established v0: real per-camera config validation, GStreamer pipeline description generation, and MediaMTX paths.yml generation, exposed via 'config validate'/'config gst'/'config mediamtx'. Real bounded frame buffering (drop-oldest backpressure, provably bounded memory under a slow consumer) and a real deterministic reconnect/backoff policy for a dropped camera link, exposed via 'stream simulate'. Added hailo_runtime.py: a real HailoRT (hailo_platform) integration boundary - open_vdevice()/load_hailo_detection_model() against the real confirmed API, lazily imported so this dev machine (no hailort installed) degrades to a clear RuntimeError; real pre-flight frame/input-shape validation against config.py's CameraConfig, fully unit-tested without hailort. 61 tests. Actually running the generated pipeline (and parsing a real model's NMS output) against physical USB cameras and a real Hailo-8 module is future work.
